ops.title: Incident: overlay conflict resolver destroyed session transcripts (2026-06-15, 2026-07-04)
ops.body:
# Incident: overlay migration conflict resolver destroyed session transcripts

**Dates**: 2026-06-15 (~17:20) and 2026-07-04 (16:07–16:12); discovered 2026-07-04 via "blank
session resume" report. **Status**: root-caused; fixed in fusekit (quarantine semantics);
lost content unrecoverable (no TM, no APFS snapshots, inodes unlinked).

## Mechanism

`fusekit overlay/migrate.go resolveFileConflict` resolved regular-file collisions by
last-write-wins on mtime and **destroyed the loser** (`os.Rename` over dst when src newer;
`os.Remove(src)` when dst newer). During backend conversions/heals, tiny freshly-written
meta-only session stubs (a few hundred bytes: `last-prompt`/`ai-title`/`mode` lines only,
written by claude resume attempts through broken overlay views during the holder-crash era)
carried newer mtimes than the real multi-MB transcripts in `~/.claude/projects` — the stub
won, the transcript's inode was unlinked. No quarantine existed.

Trigger for the Jul 4 batch: daemon restart/convergence at 16:06 found store rows for
acct-04/07/08/09/10 still fuse-era; holder-version gate refused remount; rows converged
nfs→symlink→fileprovider at 16:07–16:12, and HealStrandedPrivate merged leftover stub copies
from the raw account dirs over base. 33 conflict events in daemon.log total; more ran
CLI-side (ccp migrate during the Jul 3 recovery) without durable logs.

"Blank session resume" was exactly this: the picker lists sessions from history/meta, but the
transcript body is gone. Resume of INTACT sessions through FP domains verified working
(headless fork-resume through acct-01 read full history; projects/ is a carve-out symlink to
base — transcripts were never per-account).

## Destroyed sessions (meta-only stubs, no timestamps in file = definitive)

Jul 3–4 event:
- `-Users-yasyf/61b92778…` — "Delete the delightful Allen" (the plan-authoring session; plan
  file itself survives; session id since re-used by a live resumed session)
- `-Users-yasyf/c0d12496…` — "Verify sonnet subagent codex skill setup"
- `-Users-yasyf-Code-claude-pool/21456593…` — "Resolve acct-06 divergent fuse and symlink state"
- `-Users-yasyf-Code-claude-pool/2b68e24f…` — "Debug NFS performance and configuration errors"
- `-Users-yasyf-Code-claude-pool/596a9b37…` — "Make symlink mode changes reconcile"
- `-Users-yasyf-Code-claude-pool/93c0507d…` — "Use synckit for cross-host account syncing"
- `-Users-yasyf-Code-claude-pool/bcc99b37…` — "Resolve workspace trust dialog in Claude Code"
- `-Users-yasyf-Code-claude-pool/fc9b209c…` — "Debug CCP sessions losing authentication"
- `-Users-yasyf-Code-cc-context/b09066d0…` — "content-anchors-hashline"
- `-Users-yasyf-Code-captain-hook/96bbb882…` — "Block jj op restore and show alternatives"
- `-Users-yasyf-Code-captain-hook/1e1ab405…` — "Debug capt-hook pack and register-hooks issues"

Jun 15 event (pre-existing, unnoticed):
- `-Users-yasyf-Code-claude-pool/93e6b4c8…` — fuse unmount symlink-fallback discussion
- `-Users-yasyf-Code-claude-pool/fcd9d848…` — "Evaluate burn rate metric display"
- `-Users-yasyf-Code-dailies/cf42cc27…` — "Make sample scenarios production-ready"
- `-Users-yasyf-Code-yasyf-com/15bcba60…` — "Prepare DNS cutover to Fly infrastructure"

What survives per victim: subagent transcript dirs (`<id>/subagents/`), plan files,
`history.jsonl` prompt history, ai-titles/last-prompts. Six other conflict-listed files
(2144cb35, 7853e81b, 1333801b, 55263f7e, a2fdb8b4, cb9678b4) kept their real copy as winner;
possible unquantifiable tail loss on the discarded side.

## Fix (fusekit)

`resolveFileConflict`: newer mtime still wins at dst (ties keep dst) but the loser is renamed
to `<dst>.conflict-<loser-mtime-unixnano>` next to dst — never unlinked, never renamed over.
Pre-existing quarantine path fails loud. Suffix keeps `*.jsonl` quarantines out of claude's
transcript globs. Crash-window safe: interrupted src-newer promotion leaves dst missing +
src in place → next run heals via plain rename. Tests cover both directions, tie, identical
(no quarantine), pre-existing quarantine path, and mergeDir emptied-src removal.

Shipped: fusekit vX (quarantine), cc-pool vX (dep bump). Hard rule going forward: no
migration/heal runs on a machine whose daemon predates the quarantine resolver.
